scope: Independent read-only review of CPU diagnostic tolerance; not a new numerical root or a completed CPU06 validation.
findings: The absolute floor applies only to the near-zero reference momentum defect.
Its scale sums the absolute reference inertial, pressure, temperature/composition-gradient, gravity and tide terms, with a 1 cm/s2 lower scale.
The default compare remains numerically identical; other compact fields retain their previous tolerances.
Full F, CPU-GPU residual difference, conservation, thermal and direct required-force/flow identities retain their original acceptance criteria.
Archived strict-comparison failure is preserved. A fresh CPU06 evaluation, not this review, must establish state acceptance.
